name: Fashion Island
description: Fashion Island is Newport Beach's premier outdoor shopping destination, featuring upscale retailers, fine dining restaurants, and a cinema complex set against the stunning backdrop of coastal Southern California. This open-air lifestyle center offers a sophisticated shopping experience with luxury brands, seasonal events including nightly tree lighting ceremonies, and exceptional guest services including personal shopping. With convenient access to both shopping and dining directories, Fashion Island combines elegant retail therapy with resort-style ambiance in the heart of Newport Center.
demographics: Affluent coastal Southern California residents and visitors seeking upscale retail and dining experiences
summary: Fashion Island is Newport Beach's upscale outdoor lifestyle center featuring luxury shopping, fine dining, and entertainment in a resort-style coastal setting.
